items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: I've been going through my old notes that I made with Johnny Harmon years ago

ctx.x: That's in Algiers. Huh? That's in Algiers.

Well, maybe it is in Algiers. I think that was his… It's the only Benji in here. Benjamin… It's not Benji J., it's Benjamin. They've got it. B-E-N-J in there. 1115 Lamarck. That's the only one in there. Well, I'll have to check it again because it's been, you know, several years since I've tried to call him. I just wanted to talk to him about things. I found a lot of notes I had on the Owl. And I wanted to tell you about that too today. I've been going through my old notes that I made with Johnny Harmon years ago…

been going through my old notes that I've been going through my old notes that I've made with Johnny Harmon years ago and… I must have gotten a lot of information from Pinky one time, and Benji. Because there was such a change over in the band. Pinky came in after I left.
